subject: Next steps: Marketplace vs PO — procurement readiness and invoicing preferences (Atlas Health)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@atlashealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & ask: marketplace vs PO preference + next items

Hi Jordan / Emily — thanks again for your time earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and the commercial path.

Call highlights (TL;DR)
- Atlas Health likes Redwood’s latency/cost profile for inference—use case is clinical summarization at ~2k tokens per request.
- Procurement preference: your Finance team wants invoicing (PO) and prefers vendor billing over direct card charges; you mentioned AWS Marketplace would be ideal if it supports a PO/Private Offer flow.
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II + data residency notes required for legal review (you already shared the security questionnaire).

Open / action items (proposed)
1) I’ll send our pricing workbook and a simple SOW template for internal review (attached). Please confirm which purchase path you prefer: (A) AWS Marketplace private offer (vendor invoice + PO), (B) Direct Redwood invoice (net 30) using PO, or (C) charge card / corporate card pilot.
2) If Marketplace is preferred, please share the procurement contact and whether they require a Private Offer (POA) or can accept Marketplace listing invoice flow.
3) We’ll loop in our Marketplace onboarding and finance lead (Karthik) to clarify billing rails and timing.
4) Legal / security: Monica (cc) will follow up on the SOC2 artifacts and the DPA language.

Next meeting — propose a 30-min sync with procurement + finance next week to lock purchase path and timelines. Are you available Wed 6/30 or Thu 7/1?

Attachments: redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx (pricing workbook), sow-template.docx (SOW draft)

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@atlashealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: procurement@atlashealth.com
Date: 2026-06-28T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: marketplace vs PO preference + next items

Marcus — thanks for the summary. Quick answers below: 

- Atlas prefers an invoiced approach tied to a PO. Our standard is net 45 but we can discuss net 30 for pilots.
- AWS Marketplace would be our first choice only if we can get a Private Offer (so procurement still issues a PO against the offer and we get a vendor invoice). If Marketplace listing forces an immediate card charge or blocks PO, that won’t work for Procurement.
- Procurement and Finance are looped (procurement@atlashealth.com). I’m including Emily (Finance) to confirm timelines — she can confirm the PO cadence.
- Security: we’ll need SOC2 artifacts and the DPA redlines before legal signs off.

We can do Wed 6/30 10–11am PT for a short intake — that works for procurement and Finance.

—Jordan
Jordan Mills
Head of Data Products | Atlas Health
jordan.mills@atlashealth.com | +1 206-555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@atlashealth.com>, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & ask: marketplace vs PO preference + next items

Great — appreciate the clarity, Jordan. Confirming the plan and a few details before Wednesday: 

1) Marketplace private offer: Karthik will own the private-offer flow and confirm whether we can route vendor invoicing to your procurement PO. Karthik — can you confirm typical lead time for Private Offer creation and whether we can set payment terms to net 30/45 per the customer PO?

2) If Marketplace private offer is not feasible for any reason, our fallback is a Redwood invoice against a PO (we support net 30/45 billing). Marcus to deliver an invoice-ready commercial annex after procurement confirms fields they need.

3) Monica will push SOC2 Type II package and a draft DPA to Jordan’s legal inbox by EOD today. Monica — I attached the SOW and pricing workbook for reference.

4) Pre-read for call: I added a short note in the HubSpot deal and linked the pricing sheet (see links in the thread metadata).

Next steps before Wed 6/30 10am PT: 
- Jordan / Procurement: confirm attendees and whether procurement requires vendor tax docs/W-9 at intake.
- Atlas Finance: confirm PO billing cadence (net 30 vs 45).
- Redwood (Karthik / Monica): confirm Private Offer feasibility and send SOC2 artifacts + DPA redlines.

Thanks — look forward to aligning on the call.

Marcus
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx, sow-template.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: marketplace PO flow and artifacts to send to Atlas Health

Marcus — internal note following the external thread. Actions I’m taking: 

- I uploaded the SOC2 Type II bundle to the Drive link and will share it with Jordan’s legal (ask: do we redact customer names from the auditor report or provide a cover letter? I recommend the cover letter + redacted pdf).
- Sending the standard Redwood DPA with a single trade-off request (data deletion timing) — will flag redlines inline.
- Karthik: please confirm Private Offer lead time. On past customers, Private Offer creation + finance setup was ~7 business days; if procurement needs faster we should offer Redwood invoice against PO as fallback.
- I’ll also prepare a short procurement intake template (fields for PO number, billing contact, tax id, invoice address) to speed the payment setup.

I’ll send the SOC2 and DPA to jordan.mills@atlashealth.com and procurement@atlashealth.com by EOD. If Jordan/Emily confirm net 30, we’ll prepare the commercial annex accordingly.

Monica Patel
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
